name: Aradera no Orochi
source:
Explore the ruined temple, defeat snake enemies and collect items and treasure. It's basically an RPG turned into a visual novel with rolling dices used during battles.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
探索被毁的寺庙，击败蛇敌人并收集物品和宝藏。它基本上是一款角色扮演游戏，变成了视觉小说，在战斗中使用滚动骰子。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
